name: Contentful
description: Contentful provides content infrastructure for digital teams, exposing management and delivery APIs and a web app for structured content.
notes: Project-authored; maintained by the Redact Secret project; not independent evidence. Candidate families were enumerated from Contentful's Authentication page and from the READMEs of three Contentful-owned repositories (the JavaScript Delivery and Management client libraries and the CLI), all read on 2026-10-04 and cited in each family's contract. The Authentication page was read through a browser session because a plain HTTP client received a bot-challenge response. The list is what those pages name, not a complete inventory.
